messages:
Maya (obs): Heads-up — Q2 proposal for Console observability. Need quick alignment by EOD so we can lock the sprint. TL;DR: cost breakdown per-route/model in dashboards, lightweight tracing hooks, and error analytics (grouping + alerts). Customer asks from Acme + FinCo on cost transparency and SLO alerts.

Ari (product): Nice. Can you paste the proposed launch criteria and a rough timeline?

Maya (obs): Sure — acceptance criteria sketch below. Expect MVP if we cut deep-dive features.
```
AC:
- Dashboard: per-route cost + top-5 hot routes; 90th-latency overlay; tenant filter
- Tracing: auto-instrument top-3 handlers, include span tag `model.variant`, baseline sampling 1-in-10, adaptive on spike
- Errors: aggregated error ratio, per-tenant error budget, Slack alert if >2% rolling 10m
- Privacy: prompt content hashed (first 32 bytes) by default; opt-out tenant flag
```

Sam (eng-runtime): 4 sprints looks possible if we reuse metrics pipeline. Note: adding `model.variant` tag requires a small router change (estimate 2 dev days + test). KV-cache spans could double span volume — careful with sampling.

Lina (research): For quality/regression detection we should capture a prompt-hash in traces, but hashing strategy matters for privacy. Hashing first 32 bytes + per-tenant salt seems ok. Need legal signoff for FinCo.

Maya (obs): Agreed re privacy. We'll default to hash+salt and expose tenant opt-out. Per-tenant anonymized cost exports are in scope for MVP light.

DevBot: deploy pipeline: metrics-pipeline/canary #455 started :building_construction:

Ari (product): Prioritization ask — which two items are highest for MVP? My pick: Cost dashboard + basic tracing tags. Error analytics can be alpha.

Sam (eng-runtime): +1. For error analytics, scope to aggregated rates + alerting only (no root-cause UI) for MVP to keep infra load low.

June (solutions): From customers: enterprise requirement = CSV export + SSO access to cost views. Acme wants nightly cost export. FinCo wants tenant-level SLO email alerts.

Maya (obs): Noted. CSV export can be scheduled sprint 3 as a parity item. SSO/permissions are infra work but we'll gate by console-perms.

Ari (product): Question on sampling: 1-in-10 baseline might miss regressions for low-volume routes. Trade-offs?

Sam (eng-runtime): Propose adaptive sampling: baseline 1-in-10, ramp to 1-in-1 on latency/error anomalies using the metrics stream. Implementation complexity: moderate but avoids huge storage blowup.

Lina (research): Also suggest a short retention for raw traces (48h) and longer for aggregated metrics to limit PII exposure.

Maya (obs): ACTIONS: @Sam estimate router change in days, @June collect two concrete customer examples for cost view (Acme/FinCo), @Lina draft privacy note and retention plan. We'll finalize scope by 5pm Fri.

June (solutions): I have Acme's export spec, will upload to this thread by EOD.

Lina (research): I'll draft a 1-pager on hashing + salt + retention and post before tomorrow's sync.

Ari (product): OK — we'll run a 15-min prioritization poker tomorrow AM and lock MVP. Thanks all :rocket:
